sentences.text:
For the Respondents : Mr. Binit Chandra, A.C. to A.A.G.-Iii
 ----
05/18.08.2023 I.A. No. 3240 of 2023 The present interlocutory application has been filed on behalf
of the petitioners seeking exemption from payment of additional court-fee.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that while filing the present writ petition, one set of court-fee has been paid as the petitioners have prayed for directing the respondents to act upon the decision taken in the public meeting held on 26.05.2016 (Annexure-4 to the writ petition) in presence of the Divisional Commissioner, Singhbhum (Kolhan) Division, Chaibasa for payment of compensation to the concerned raiyats/villagers/land losers due to acquisition of their lands for construction of 'Sitarampur Dam'.
It is further submitted that the petitioners have also made related prayers in the writ petition, however since their interest is common, they are required to pay only one set of court-fee.

In support of the said submission, learned counsel for the petitioners has put reliance on order dated 06.09.2018 passed by a Bench of this Court in W.P.(S) No. 3470 of 2016 (Ajay Kumar Yadav & Ors. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Ors.).

entities.text: Ajay Kumar Yadav & Ors. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Binit Chandra, learned A.C. to A.A.G.-III appearing on behalf of the respondents, opposes the said submission of learned counsel for the petitioners and submits that the petitioners have claimed themselves to be the displaced persons due to acquisition of their lands for construction of 'Sitarampur Dam' and if their prayer made in the writ petition is allowed, they will be individually getting compensation in addition to availing the benefit of rehabilitation policy.
I find substance in the submission of learned counsel for the respondents.

Though the petitioners have prayed for issuance of direction upon the respondent authorities to act upon the decision taken in the public meeting dated 26.05.2016 in presence of the Divisional Commissioner, Singhbhum (Kolhan) Division, Chaibasa, yet if the said prayer is allowed, the consequence of the same will be that all the petitioners will get the compensation as well as the benefits of rehabilitation policy Dinesh Mahato & Ors vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197461074/
1 separately.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under the said circumstance, their interest can be said to be similar but not common.
Hence, the petitioners are required to pay additional court-fee as per the report of the office.

Learned counsel for the petitioners prays for and is allowed time till 01.09.2023 for payment of additional court-fee as well as for removing the remaining defect(s) pointed out by the office, failing which the present writ petition shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that while filing the present writ petition, one set of court-fee has been paid as the petitioners have prayed for directing the respondents to act upon the decision taken in the public meeting held on 26.05.2016 (Annexure-4 to the writ petition) in presence of the Divisional Commissioner, Singhbhum (Kolhan) Division, Chaibasa for payment of compensation to the concerned raiyats/villagers/land losers due to acquisition of their lands for construction of 'Sitarampur Dam'.
In support of the said submission, learned counsel for the petitioners has put reliance on order dated 06.09.2018 passed by a Bench of this Court in W.P.(S) No. 3470 of 2016 (Ajay Kumar Yadav & Ors. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Ors.).

opennyai_summary.decision:
Though the petitioners have prayed for issuance of direction upon the respondent authorities to act upon the decision taken in the public meeting dated 26.05.2016 in presence of the Divisional Commissioner, Singhbhum (Kolhan) Division, Chaibasa, yet if the said prayer is allowed, the consequence of the same will be that all the petitioners will get the compensation as well as the benefits of rehabilitation policy Dinesh Mahato & Ors vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197461074/
1 separately.
Under the said circumstance, their interest can be said to be similar but not common.
Hence, the petitioners are required to pay additional court-fee as per the report of the office.
I.A. No. 3240 of 2023 stands dismissed.
Learned counsel for the petitioners prays for and is allowed time till 01.09.2023 for payment of additional court-fee as well as for removing the remaining defect(s) pointed out by the office, failing which the present writ petition shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
